findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Dynamic Regex Construction
 * @description Finds regex compilations where the pattern is not a string literal, indicating potential regex injection.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/dynamic-regex
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-1333
 *       external/cwe/cwe-777
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call, DataFlow::Node pattern
where
  call = API::moduleImport("re").getMember(["compile", "search", "match", "findall", "finditer", "split", "sub", "subn"]).getACall() and
  pattern = call.getArg(0) and
  not pattern.asExpr() instanceof StringLiteral
select call, "Regex pattern is not a string literal: $@", pattern, "pattern"
findings.hypothesis: Dynamic construction of regular expressions might allow for ReDoS or other regex-based attacks if user input is included.

/**
 * @name Extract code around ReDoS sinks
 * @description Extract code lines around identified ReDoS sinks to understand context
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity info
 * @id py/extract-redos-context
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from Call call, Location loc
where
  (
    call.getLocation().getFile().getShortName() = "css_parser.py" and
    call.getLocation().getStartLine() in [1112, 1114, 1122]
  ) or
  (
    call.getLocation().getFile().getShortName() = "util.py" and
    call.getLocation().getStartLine() = 90
  )
select call, "Code at line " + call.getLocation().getStartLine().toString()

/**

 * @description Find calls to re.escape in css_parser.py to see if user input is escaped.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity info
 * @id py/check-re-escape
 * @tags audit
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("re").getMember("escape").getACall() and
  call.getLocation().getFile().getShortName() = "css_parser.py"
select call, "Call to re.escape"
findings.hypothesis: Checking if user input is escaped before being used in regex to prevent ReDoS.
